schema.title: Response List Entitlements Api V1 Entitlements Get

post.description:
Authoritative payment confirmation (plan §11.2). Protected by
`X-Razorpay-Signature` over the **raw** body, verified before anything is parsed — not by
a bearer token, so this route is public in the route-coverage sense and carries the plan's
"Sig" policy instead. Always durably logs the event first, then returns 2xx fast; heavy
follow-up (entitlement grants) happens in the same transaction as that log, but the HTTP
response itself doesn't wait on any outbound call.

post.description:
Build a day-by-day plan toward `exam_date` from the caller's mastery, the exam's syllabus
weights, topic prerequisites and open mistakes. Replaces any earlier active plan for the exam.
Leave `exam_date` out to use the exam's next published exam date (400 `exam_date_required`
if none is published); the plan records which one it used. A date you send is always used.
`daily_minutes` defaults to the profile's daily study minutes, else 90. Needs an
`Idempotency-Key` header; a retry returns the same plan.

ActionOut.description:
What the client should do when the student taps the item. `body` is ready to send; the
practice endpoints also need an `Idempotency-Key` header. A locked item's action is always
`purchase`: it never carries the id or path of the locked content.

Admin grants (goodwill, trial, support cases) are tied to a real product: it supplies the
exam, the component(s) granted (both, for a COMBO) and the default validity, exactly as a
purchase of it would. `entitlements.product_id` is never null, purchased or not.
